models.name: Elastic artery
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A cut length of a large elastic artery showing its layered wall, from the endothelium out through the elastic media to the adventitia.

models.name: Arterial vessel tour
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: An animated journey along the inside of an artery, with red and white blood cells travelling past the vessel wall.

models.name: Human heart
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: A beating heart opened up so the four chambers can be explored from inside.

models.name: Human heart with coronary vessels
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: The external surface of the heart with the coronary arteries and cardiac veins traced across it.

models.name: Brain aneurysm exploration
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: The arteries at the base of the brain isolated to show where berry aneurysms form, with an aneurysm treated by endovascular coiling.

models.name: Glomerulus of the human kidney
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: The capillary tuft of a renal glomerulus inside its capsule, where blood is first filtered on its way through the nephron.

models.name: Alveolar sacs cut section
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: A cut cluster of alveolar sacs wrapped in capillaries, showing the surface where oxygen crosses into the blood.

models.name: Neuron action potential
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: A pyramidal neuron taking input on its dendrites and firing an action potential down its axon.

models.name: Brain explorer
models.author: bblakesley
models.summary: An explorable brain whose regions can be taken apart and examined one at a time.

models.name: Human heart (3D animated)
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: An unlabelled beating heart seen from outside. The stumps of the aorta, pulmonary trunk and venae cavae sit at its base, and red coronary arteries branch over its surface.

models.name: Cardiovascular system
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: An unlabelled whole-body map of the main arteries and veins, running from the heart and aorta out to the head, hands and legs.

models.name: Muscular artery
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A short piece of a medium-sized distributing artery whose wall pulls apart into four labelled layers: the endothelium, the elastic tissue, a thick band of smooth muscle and the fibrous outer coat.

models.name: Cardiac conduction system
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A see-through heart with the electrical conduction pathway picked out and labelled, running from the SA and AV nodes through the bundle of His and both bundle branches to the moderator band and the Purkinje fibres.
structures: Anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle

models.name: Heart, valves and auscultation sites
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A see-through heart with the trachea and bronchi, its valves visible inside, and five markers for the stethoscope points: the second right, second left, third left and fourth left intercostal spaces and the apex. The markers are labelled in Dutch.
structures: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve

models.name: Cardiac anatomy: coronary arteries of the heart
models.author: HannahNewey
models.summary: A finely sculpted heart focused on its blood supply. Fourteen annotations follow the left and right coronary arteries and their branches, including the anterior interventricular, circumflex, marginal, SA nodal and posterior interventricular arteries.

models.name: Cardiac anatomy: external view of the heart
models.author: HannahNewey
models.summary: A detailed outside view of the heart with 20 labels. They cover the chambers and auricles, the aorta, the pulmonary trunk and veins, the venae cavae, the ligamentum arteriosum, both coronary arteries, and the coronary sinus with its cardiac veins.

models.name: Human heart with pulmonary vessels
models.author: SGUMedArt
models.summary: A heart built from MRI data, with the pericardium removed and the pulmonary arteries and veins traced deep into their branching trees in the lungs. Twelve annotations follow blood through the heart, the lungs and out into the aorta.

models.name: Internal human heart anatomy
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: An opened heart from a university anatomy centre with 20 labels on the inside: the chambers, fossa ovalis, interventricular septum, all four valves, chordae tendineae, papillary muscles and trabeculae carneae.

models.name: Plastinated heart: classic valve view
models.author: VisibleHeartLabs
models.summary: An unlabelled 3D scan of a real preserved donor heart, cut across its base so all four valves are seen together from above, with the removed atria placed beside it.
structures: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve

models.name: Mesenteric artery wall
models.author: GLS
models.summary: A small mesenteric artery wall rebuilt from confocal microscopy. The endothelium, elastic laminae, elastin fibres, sympathetic nerve fibres and surrounding perivascular fat are each colour-coded and labelled.

models.name: Bicuspid aortic valve
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A heart whose aortic valve has two leaflets instead of three, the most common congenital valve defect, with 18 labels on the chambers, great vessels and valves. The label on the abnormal valve reads 'Bicuspid pulmonary valve', although the defect is in the aortic valve.

models.name: Ventricular septal defect
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A heart with its lungs and great vessels showing two holes in the wall between the ventricles: a perimembranous one close to the valves and a muscular one lower down. There are 17 labels.
structures: Septal leaflet of right atrioventricular valve

models.name: Artery atherosclerosis: plaque and consequences
models.author: Deepankar.Parmar
models.summary: A row of cut-open artery segments with large 3D captions. It steps from a normal wall through a fatty streak, atheroma and fibrous plaque to plaque rupture, clot formation and a plaque that blocks the lumen.

models.name: Anatomy of the skin
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: Schematic block of hair-bearing skin made for a Groningen dermatology course, with the epidermis, dermis and subcutaneous fat stacked in layers and follicles, sweat glands and vessels running through them.

models.name: Human skin - integumentary system
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Photoreal cut block of skin in which hair shafts rise out of follicles, surrounded by sebaceous and sweat glands, a web of vessels and nerves, and a fatty hypodermis at the base.

models.name: Psoriasis skin cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Skin block showing a psoriatic plaque, where the epidermis is thickened and heaped into scales over the dermis, follicles and glands below.

models.name: Finger and Fingernail Cross Section Anatomy
models.author: h3ydari96
models.summary: Fingertip split lengthways to show how the nail plate, nail bed and nail folds sit over the distal phalanx, with the pulp and skin layers around them.
structures: Distal phalanx of third finger of hand

models.name: Long Bone
models.author: iqcenter
models.summary: Schematic wedge of a long-bone shaft that exposes ringed osteons in the compact cortex, a trabecular inner zone and marrow, with colour-coded vessels and nerve running through the canals.

models.name: Bone CS
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Upper femur sectioned through the head, neck and trochanter to show the dense cortical rim around a lattice of spongy bone.

models.name: Skeletal muscle structure (actin & myosin)
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Step-by-step breakdown of a generic skeletal muscle, from a sheathed bundle of fascicles down through single fibres and myofibrils to the actin and myosin filaments, with a motor nerve attached.

models.name: Knee Anatomy Model
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: University of Dundee model of a right knee that pairs the femur, tibia, fibula and patella with the main stabilising ligaments and tendons, including the cruciates, both collaterals and the patellar ligament.

models.name: Knee anatomy: bones and cartilage
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: Left knee reduced to its bones, with hand-sculpted articular cartilage and the two menisci lying on the tibial plateau.

models.name: The Glenohumeral Joint
models.author: AUmedart
models.summary: Shoulder model from a medical-illustration graduate programme, built from imaging data, that shows the scapula and humerus with the capsular ligaments, the four rotator cuff muscles and the biceps.

models.name: Ligaments of Shoulder Girdle
models.author: docjana
models.summary: Clavicle, scapula and upper humerus shown with the ligaments that bind them: acromioclavicular, coracoclavicular, coraco-acromial, superior transverse scapular, glenohumeral and transverse humeral, plus the long biceps tendon.

models.name: Deep Hip Joint
models.author: ubcmedvid
models.summary: 3D scan of a real UBC cadaver dissection in which the femoral head has been dislocated, exposing the acetabular socket, its labrum and the ligament of the femoral head.

models.name: Visible Interactive Human - Exploding skull
models.author: witmerlab
models.summary: Animated skull built from a CT scan that gradually pulls apart into its separate cranial and facial bones, like a classic exploded-skull preparation.

models.name: Vertebral column
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Whole spine from the first cervical vertebra to the coccyx, with intervertebral discs between the vertebral bodies and the normal cervical, thoracic and lumbar curves.

models.name: Pelvic skeleton (pelvis)
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Articulated bony pelvis built from the two hip bones, sacrum and coccyx, meeting at the sacro-iliac joints and the pubic symphysis.

models.name: Ligaments of the Female Pelvis
models.author: tilt
models.summary: University of Dundee teaching model of a female pelvis with its main ligaments, including the sacrospinous, sacrotuberous, iliolumbar and sacro-iliac ligaments, checked for accuracy by anatomists.

models.name: Bones of the Hand
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: University of Dundee hand skeleton coloured by group, so the carpals, metacarpals and each row of phalanges stand out from one another.

models.name: Foot bones
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Articulated foot skeleton showing how the tarsals, metatarsals and phalanges fit together to form the arches.

models.name: Achilles Tendon Rupture
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: Leg and foot skeleton with the calf muscles in place, showing the calcaneal (Achilles) tendon torn just above where it attaches to the heel bone.

models.name: knee osteoarthritis stages
models.author: Deepankar.Parmar
models.summary: Four labelled knees in a row, running from healthy to severe osteoarthritis, showing cartilage wearing away, the joint space narrowing, osteophytes forming and the synovium changing.

models.name: Anatomy of the airways
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A CT-based sculpt of the trachea and bronchial tree branching inside translucent lungs, built by a university medical centre for a course on thoracic imaging.

models.name: Lung animation
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: An animation of the lungs, airways and diaphragm in which the lungs expand and recoil as the diaphragm contracts and relaxes during quiet breathing.

models.name: Epithelium of the Trachea
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-by-cell model of the tracheal lining, with ciliated pseudostratified columnar cells and goblet cells all sitting on an unusually thick basal lamina.

models.name: Covid-19 patient's lungs version1 (animated)
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Animated lungs, one of them cut away to show the bronchial tree and patches of inflamed, fluid-filled tissue typical of COVID-19 pneumonia.

models.name: Gastrointestinal tract
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The whole digestive tube with its accessory organs, placed in the trunk against the skeleton, the diaphragm and the lower airways.

models.name: Stomach cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A stomach opened up to expose its longitudinal, circular and oblique muscle coats and the rugal folds of its lining.

models.name: Epithelium of the Duodenum
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of a duodenal villus covered by simple columnar absorptive cells with goblet cells scattered among them.

models.name: Epithelium of the Colon
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of colonic mucosa, with straight crypts lined by simple columnar cells and many goblet cells.

models.name: Pancreas and duodenum
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The pancreas lying in the C-shaped loop of the duodenum, with its duct and the bile duct running to where they drain into the gut.

models.name: Abdomen Anatomy
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A university teaching model of the abdominal organs and great vessels, with an animation that turns the overlying organs transparent to reveal the pancreas.

models.name: Ulcerative colitis VS Crohn's disease
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: Two diseased large bowels side by side, setting the continuous inflammation of ulcerative colitis against the patchy skip lesions of Crohn's disease.

models.name: Kidney cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A halved kidney showing the cortex and the medullary pyramids, which drain through the calyces into the renal pelvis and ureter, with the renal vessels entering at the hilum.

models.name: Nephron
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A single nephron traced from its glomerulus through the convoluted tubules and loop of Henle to the collecting duct, together with the blood vessels that supply it.

models.name: Epithelium of the Bladder
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of the urothelium, the layered transitional lining of the bladder in which only the lowest cells touch the basal lamina.

models.name: Urinary tract
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A CT-based model of the kidneys, ureters and bladder shown in place within the skeleton, made by a university medical centre for an imaging course.

models.name: Polycystic kidney
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A sculpted kidney swollen and misshapen by many cysts of different sizes, illustrating polycystic kidney disease.

models.name: Hemisected brain
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: A brain cut along the midline with 20 labels on its medial and deep parts, including the corpus callosum, fornix, thalamus, caudate and lentiform nuclei, hippocampus, amygdala, pineal body, pituitary and third ventricle.

models.name: Ventricles
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: The ventricular system shown as a cast inside a see-through brain, with 20 labels on the horns of the lateral ventricle, the third and fourth ventricles, the cerebral aqueduct, the interventricular foramen, the median and lateral apertures and the choroid plexus.

models.name: Regions of the brain
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: A brain with each lobe in its own colour, labelled for the frontal, parietal, temporal and occipital lobes, the central sulcus with the gyri on either side, the longitudinal fissure and the cerebellum.

models.name: Cranial nerves and brain stem
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The brainstem and cerebellum on their own with the cranial nerves branching out from them and the optic nerves running to both eyeballs, with labels on the brainstem, cerebellum, optic chiasm, trigeminal nerve and pituitary.

models.name: Cranial Nerves
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: A whole brain viewed from below showing where all twelve cranial nerves emerge, with a note on each giving its attachment to the brain, its exit from the skull, its fibre type and what it supplies.

models.name: The brain and brain nuclei
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A see-through brain with the deep grey nuclei in their true positions, labelled for the caudate and putamen, globus pallidus, thalamus, fornix and ventricles.

models.name: Corte sagital de cabeza / Sagittal head section
models.author: Gonzalo_Matzner
models.summary: A 3D scan of a real cadaver head cut down the midline, with 20 labels in Spanish (with English glosses) covering the corpus callosum, septum pellucidum, falx cerebri, pituitary, hypothalamus, brainstem parts, cerebellar fissures, fourth ventricle and nearby arteries.

models.name: Nerves with a skeletal cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: An overview of the whole nervous system with the skull and spine cut open, so the brain, the spinal cord in its dural sheath and the spinal nerves spreading out to the body can all be seen, with labels on both dural layers, the brainstem, olfactory nerve and pituitary.

models.name: Spinal cord transverse section coverings label
models.author: Deepankar.Parmar
models.summary: A length of spinal cord with its meningeal coverings, paired nerve roots and dorsal root ganglia, cut across so the ascending and descending tracts can be seen, with labels built into the model.

models.name: Nerve cell (neuron and oligo-dendrocyte)
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: A single neuron modelled at cell scale, labelled for its cell body, axon and nerve endings, with an oligodendrocyte wrapping the axon in a myelin sheath.

models.name: Eye cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: An eyeball cut in half to show the sclera, choroid and retina as three layers, along with the lens on its suspensory ligaments, with labels on the cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina and conjunctiva.

models.name: Nerves of the Eye
models.author: anatomy_dundee
models.summary: The nerves supplying the eye, traced from the brainstem into the orbit inside a see-through skull (optic, oculomotor, trochlear, trigeminal and abducens nerves, plus the ciliary ganglion), with 20 colour-coded notes that also walk through the sympathetic and parasympathetic pathways of the pupillary light reflex.

models.name: Ear cross-section
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The ear sectioned from the auricle inward, following the external auditory meatus to the tympanic membrane, the ossicles, the bony labyrinth, the vestibulocochlear nerve and the Eustachian tube.

models.name: Anatomy of the Inner Ear
models.author: tilt
models.summary: A University of Dundee model of the middle and inner ear built largely from segmented MRI data, with 13 labels on the eardrum, malleus, incus and stapes, the three semicircular canals, the cochlea, and the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves with the chorda tympani and greater petrosal branches.

models.name: Orofacial anatomy with blood and nerve supply
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The jaws and full set of teeth with their blood and nerve supply, with 18 labels covering the carotid branches, the jugular and facial veins, the pterygoid venous plexus, and the trigeminal ganglion with its maxillary, mandibular and infraorbital branches.

models.name: Tireoide/  Thyroid / Prof. Dr. Gustavo Penna
models.author: DGF
models.summary: A teaching model from the UFMG medical faculty showing the thyroid gland in place on the larynx and trachea, with 10 Portuguese notes on the gland, the parathyroids, the thyroid and cricoid cartilages, the cricothyroid ligament, the thyrohyoid membrane, the hyoid, the epiglottis and the oesophagus.

models.name: Adrenal gland antomy histology endocrine label
models.author: Deepankar.Parmar
models.summary: A whole suprarenal gland shown next to a large cut-away block of its wall that lays out the capsule, the three cortical zones and the medulla, with labels and blood-flow direction built into the model.

models.name: Male reproductive system
models.author: Ebers
models.summary: The male reproductive tract in place, running from the testis and epididymis up the spermatic cord to the seminal vesicle and prostate and out to the penis, with a descriptive note on each main part.

models.name: Testis Cut Section With Labels detail
models.author: Deepankar.Parmar
models.summary: A testis split open inside its coverings to show its lobules and seminiferous tubules draining into the rete testis and epididymis, with gross and microscopic labels built into the model.
